rationale: The Court is most likely to issue a narrow, precedent-tethered opinion treating state legal/functional responsibility for judgments as the dominant Hess “financial safety net” factor and rejecting waiver absent an unmistakably clear statement covering sister-state courts. Separate writings are most likely from the dissenters pressing functional separateness/dignity and from Thomas/Alito (and possibly Gorsuch) to emphasize originalist structural immunity and a strict clear-statement rule.
